states: Before (main): a fresh server started with PULSE_TELEMETRY=false, setup with Usage statistics switched off, showed "Your admin account was created, but usage statistics could not be turned off" after the 409 env_locked reply
After: the same setup gets the 409, reads /api/system/settings (telemetryEnabled false), shows no message and continues to Connect your first system
The locked-on and unreadable cases are covered by SecurityStep tests; the step layout is unchanged at phone width
interactions: Started a fresh data directory, verified the bootstrap token, switched Usage statistics off, created the admin account
Read the network calls: settings update 409, settings read 200, no error toast
